name: Descent into the Charnel Trenches & Vox to the Spire

cycle_advancement.world_state: Sump Charnel Reconnaissance & Spire Vox Petition

locations_modified.ambient_tension: Thick sulfuric sludge and discarded machine debris. Flashlight beams cut through oily mist to reveal massive gouges torn into the ferrocrete runoff foundations—something colossal and ravenous made this its burrow.

new_milestone.title: Charnel Trench Reconnaissance & Salvage
new_milestone.consequence: Sergeant Vane and Jax uncovered the lair of a subterranean Sump Carnifex-Beast driving vermin upward; salvaged 3 water purification valves and an intact heavy stubber ammo cache.

sump_sewer_scuttlers.name: Sump Sewer-Scuttlers
notable_kills: Alpha Brood-Scuttler: bisected by Sergeant Kathryn Vane's Chainsword Mk. VII
4 Heavy Armored Scuttlers: skull-pulped by Bone 'ead Bragg's Power Fist
Drainage Swarm (37 scuttlers): concentrated lasfire and Trooper Jax's 2 frag canisters

feral_sump_stalkers.name: Feral Sump Stalkers
notable_kills: 5 forward mutant scouts picked off by Bastion Heavy Stubber overwatch during welding phase

active_resource_stockpile.quarantine_logistics_alert: Spire HQ denies immediate supply hauler dispatch due to quarantine edict. Corpse-starch reserves at 3.1 days; emergency local rendering or tithe compliance required.

new_decision.decision: Descended into the toxic Sump Charnel Ditches with Jax and Bragg while petitioning Spire HQ via Kroll's vox link; uncovered the nest of a massive burrowing sump predator and secured salvage.
new_decision.impact: Pinpointed the root cause of the incursion and recovered critical Munitorum stubber ammo and water valves.

new_decision.decision: Guided the Sergeant through the sludge shoals and sniffed out an abandoned Munitorum locker containing 4 heavy stubber belts and 3 brass valves.
new_decision.impact: Boosted garrison heavy ammo reserves and located the predator's toxic slime trail.

new_decision.decision: Waded waist-deep in toxic run-off to haul the iron salvage locker back to safety, growling at the dark vents.
new_decision.impact: Secured the salvage point and shielded the squad from subterranean ambushes.

new_decision.decision: Opened encrypted binharic channel to Spire High Command requesting munition and ration relief.
new_decision.impact: High Command refused direct transport due to orbital quarantine, but promised a relief drop if Level 404 completes its upcoming macro-cannon shell quota.
